changelog_text:
## Changes
- The fairing half and base now come from the fairing family of [Fairings by Purrline Rocketworks](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-PurrlineFairings): the same shape, size, part Ids and connectors, with a black carbon variant of the half (press V on a placed half) and a quilted acoustic blanket inside.
- New names: Fairing Half 2 m Medium and Fairing Base 2 m.
- A stronger split (930 N s instead of 800 N s), so the halves clear the payload also under thrust.
- Vehicles that you saved with Prisma 1.0.0 load with their fairing.
- Prisma does not need Fairings by Purrline Rocketworks: it contains the same 2 m fairing. You can install both mods together, in any mod order.
- All other parts are the same as in 1.0.0.

## Compatibility
Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.10.5801**.
**Update Prisma 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 before you enable Fairings by Purrline Rocketworks.** Prisma 1.0.0 contains the same fairing parts in an older form, and with Prisma 1.0.0 and Fairings enabled together the fairing does not load.

## Installation
Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\PurrlinePrisma\`.
No mod loader needed. Requires [Extended Propellants](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-ExtendedPropellants).

listing.name: Prisma by Purrline Rocketworks
listing.abstract: A two-stage small satellite launcher kit with a nine-engine first stage, an upper stage, a fairing and a launch ground set, built to fit beside the stock parts.
listing.description:
![Prisma on the pad](ksa-image:pad-hero)

**Prisma** is a two-stage small satellite launcher for Kitten Space Agency, from the fictional rocket maker **Purrline Rocketworks**. It is inspired by Spectrum from Isar Aerospace.

The rocket is about 28 m tall. Sizes and texture density follow the stock parts, so Prisma mixes with stock tanks and engines. The engines burn liquid oxygen and propane.

## Parts

- **Fairing Half 2 m Medium**: fairing half, 6.10 m long; place two; white or black carbon (press V).
- **Fairing Base 2 m**: fairing base ring with the 1 m payload adapter.
- **Prisma Payload Mass Simulator (1 t)**: 1000 kg dummy payload for test flights.
- **Prisma Stage 2**: upper stage with a tank, an Altair Vac and four RCS blocks.
- **Prisma Interstage**: interstage with its own decoupler; the Altair Vac sits inside.
- **Prisma Stage 1 Tank**: the 2 m first stage tank.
- **Altair Engine Bay**: nine Altair engines, each with its own gimbal.
- **Altair**: single sea level engine.
- **Altair Vac**: single vacuum engine with the long nozzle.
- **Prisma Hold-down Ring**: holds the rocket on the pad and releases at lift-off.
- **Prisma Strongback**: tower beside the rocket; stays on the pad.

The fairing is the 2 m fairing of Fairings by Purrline Rocketworks, with a quilted acoustic blanket inside. Prisma contains it, so you do not need Fairings for it, and you can install both mods together.

![All parts](ksa-image:all-parts)

![The engine bay](ksa-image:engine-bay)

![Ascent at dusk](ksa-image:ascent-dusk)

![Prisma in orbit](ksa-image:in-orbit)

## Requirements

[Extended Propellants](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-ExtendedPropellants) is required. Without it the engines do not load.

Works well with [Andoya Spaceport](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AndoyaSpaceport) (a pad for Prisma), [Facet](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-PurrlineFacet) (satellites for the fairing) and [Fairings by Purrline Rocketworks](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-PurrlineFairings) (3 m fairings and hammerhead bases).

## Install

- Borea: install Prisma from the content list. Borea adds Extended Propellants.
- By hand: copy `PurrlinePrisma` and `ExtendedPropellants` from the release zips into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/` and enable both. If you also use Fairings by Purrline Rocketworks and have Prisma 1.0.0, update Prisma first: Prisma 1.0.0 and Fairings together do not load the fairing.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Vehicles with its parts do not load without it.

Made for KSA build 2026.11.10.5801.
